title: La entretenida by Miguel de Cervantes: A Digital, Annotated Edition and an English Translation
author: Miguel de Cervantes
institution: King's College London, Out of the Wings project (John O'Neill, Paul Spence)
notes: Edition of Cervantes's play from the 1615 first edition (Ocho comedias y ocho entremeses), in several versions: facsimile, modern-spelling transcription, edited text and unpunctuated text, with an English translation, indices, a map and performance information. Counts are ours: one play, about 19,200 words in the first-edition (modern-spelling) text pages including front matter, without line numbers. Site marked 2018; its newest file is from May 2023, so nothing changed in the last three years.
